provenance.existing: The generation cadence is measured from the 46 platform and CPU launch events already recorded in design/catalog-2016-2020/*.json. The 2016 anchor is the IDC figure already recorded in docs/market-reference.md.
provenance.new: Every yearly demand index, parts-cost index, era name and the 2021-2030 cadence are original game design, not verified market data. The selling-price index is derived from the parts-cost index at a 70 percent pass-through, so a cost saving is mostly handed to the customer instead of becoming pure margin.
provenance.limits: A pacing model for the fifteen-year game, not a shipment forecast. Only 2016 is a verified market anchor; 2021 is an unopened lead; every other year is a design projection.

basisLevels.verified_anchor: Read from a source actually opened and recorded in docs/market-reference.md
basisLevels.lead: Seen only in a search result title that could not be opened; direction only, never a fact
basisLevels.design_projection: Original game design, chosen so the fifteen years have a playable rhythm

cadence.note: 2016-2020 目录实测每年约 14.4 个事件、8.6 个平台或处理器发布事件，节奏密集且跨 CPU 与 GPU 两条线。2021-2030 沿用同一密度，让玩家的定型设计持续面临过时压力。发布间隔本身没有从目录推出可验证的固定周期，因此不写成具体月数。
